name: Mistral AI
summary: Mistral AI is an AI company based in Paris. Arthur Mensch, Guillaume Lample and Timothée Lacroix [founded it in 2023](https://www.reuters.com/technology/french-company-mistral-ai-raises-105-mln-euros-shortly-after-being-set-up-2023-06-13/). It makes open-weight and commercial models, and the Le Chat assistant.

incidents.title: Mistral AI Released Mistral 7B With No Moderation and No Reported Safety Evaluation
incidents.summary: Mistral released its first model, Mistral 7B, as a torrent with no moderation mechanism. A safety researcher and 404 Media reported that it gave instructions for murder and discussed the benefits of ethnic cleansing. Mistral later added a statement that the model has no moderation.
incidents.description: In September 2023, Mistral AI released its first open-weight model, Mistral 7B, with no moderation mechanism. [According to 404 Media](https://www.404media.co/260-million-ai-company-releases-chatbot-that-gives-detailed-instructions-on-murder-ethnic-cleansing/), tests by a researcher and by the outlet showed that the instruct model gave instructions for murder and suicide and discussed the benefits of ethnic cleansing. Mistral added a statement to its [release page](https://mistral.ai/news/announcing-mistral-7b/) that the model has no moderation.

timeline.description: Mistral published the model and an [announcement](https://mistral.ai/news/announcing-mistral-7b/).

incidents.title: Weights of an Early Mistral AI Model Leaked as "miqu-1-70b"
incidents.summary: A user posted the weights of a model called "miqu-1-70b" on Hugging Face and 4chan. Mistral CEO Arthur Mensch confirmed that an employee of an early access customer leaked a quantized and watermarked version of an old Mistral model.
incidents.description: A user posted the weights of a model named "miqu-1-70b" on Hugging Face and 4chan. [Mistral CEO Arthur Mensch said](https://the-decoder.com/unintentional-ai-leak-from-mistral-becomes-an-unexpected-powerhouse/) that an employee of an early access customer leaked a quantized and watermarked version of an old Mistral model. [Mistral did not ask](https://venturebeat.com/business/mistral-ceo-confirms-leak-of-new-open-source-ai-model-nearing-gpt-4-performance) for removal of the weights.

incidents.title: Mistral AI Did Not Publish a Frontier Safety Framework Despite Its Seoul Commitment
incidents.summary: Mistral signed the Frontier AI Safety Commitments in May 2024, which ask signatories to publish a safety framework before the February 2025 AI Action Summit in France. Trackers report that Mistral has not published one.
incidents.description: Under the [Seoul commitments](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/frontier-ai-safety-commitments-ai-seoul-summit-2024/frontier-ai-safety-commitments-ai-seoul-summit-2024), Mistral AI agreed to publish a safety framework with thresholds for severe risks before the AI Action Summit in Paris in February 2025. [SaferAI lists Mistral](https://tracker.safer-ai.org/methodology/) among six companies that did not publish their frameworks despite their commitments. Other trackers also report no published Mistral framework.

timeline.title: Mistral signs the Seoul commitments
timeline.description: Mistral AI was one of the 16 original signatories ([UK government](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/frontier-ai-safety-commitments-ai-seoul-summit-2024/frontier-ai-safety-commitments-ai-seoul-summit-2024)).

incidents.title: Red-Team Report Says Mistral AI's Pixtral Models Produced Child Sexual Exploitation and CBRN Content
incidents.summary: Enkrypt AI reported that Mistral's Pixtral-Large (25.02) and Pixtral-12B were 60 times more likely than GPT-4o and Claude 3.7 Sonnet to produce child sexual exploitation material (CSEM), and 18 to 40 times more likely to produce dangerous CBRN information. Mistral said it has "a zero tolerance policy on child safety" and would examine the report.
incidents.description: [Enkrypt AI reported](https://www.enkryptai.com/newsroom/multimodal-ai-safety-report-mistral) that two Mistral Pixtral models were 60 times more likely than GPT-4o and Claude 3.7 Sonnet to produce child sexual exploitation material. The report also said that the models gave dangerous chemical, biological, radiological and nuclear (CBRN) information, mostly in reply to prompts hidden in images. [Mistral said](https://www.euronews.com/next/2025/05/08/mistral-ai-models-60-times-more-prone-to-generate-child-sexual-exploitation-content-than-o) that it would examine the report.

timeline.title: Enkrypt AI publishes the report
timeline.description: Enkrypt AI released its multimodal red-team report on the two Pixtral models ([Enkrypt AI](https://www.enkryptai.com/newsroom/multimodal-ai-safety-report-mistral), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/next/2025/05/08/mistral-ai-models-60-times-more-prone-to-generate-child-sexual-exploitation-content-than-o)).

incidents.title: Malicious Versions of Mistral AI SDK Packages Published in a Supply-Chain Attack
incidents.summary: Mistral's own [security advisory MAI-2026-002](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/security-advisories/MAI-2026-002) says that the Mini Shai-Hulud supply-chain attack caused compromised versions of its npm and PyPI SDKs to be published. Mistral says the PyPI version ran a script that harvests credentials, and that an affected developer device was involved, with no impact on Mistral global infrastructure.
incidents.description: In May 2026, an automated worm in the Mini Shai-Hulud supply-chain attack published compromised versions of Mistral's npm and PyPI SDKs. [Mistral said](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/security-advisories/MAI-2026-002) that the npm versions did not work, but the PyPI version ran a script that collects credentials. Mistral removed the versions and told affected users to change all secrets that those systems can access.

timeline.title: Compromised npm versions published
timeline.description: Compromised npm SDK versions were available from 22:45 UTC on May 11 to 01:53 UTC on May 12 ([Mistral GitHub advisory](https://github.com/mistralai/client-ts/security/advisories/GHSA-jgg6-4rpr-wfh7)).

incidents.title: Mistral AI's Vibe Coding Agent Could Run Shell Commands Without the Expected Approval
incidents.summary: Mistral's [security advisory MAI-2026-003](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/security-advisories/MAI-2026-003) says that six vulnerabilities in the shell permission checks of its Vibe coding agent let crafted commands run without the expected approval prompt. Mistral says malicious instructions in content that the agent processed could cause such commands.
incidents.description: [HiddenLayer reported](https://www.hiddenlayer.com/sai-security-advisory/2026-09-mistral-vibe6) six vulnerabilities in the shell permission checks of Mistral's Vibe coding agent. [According to Mistral](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/security-advisories/MAI-2026-003), crafted commands could run without the expected approval prompt, for example because of malicious instructions in content that the agent processed. Mistral fixed the issues in Vibe 2.25.4 and reports no confirmed exploitation.

timeline.description: HiddenLayer published six CVE advisories on Vibe's shell permission checks ([HiddenLayer](https://www.hiddenlayer.com/sai-security-advisory/2026-09-mistral-vibe6)).

incidents.title: Token in Mistral AI's Le Chat Coding Sandbox Opened Internal Models and Tools
incidents.summary: [Vero Security said](https://www.vero.security/blog/your-agents-sandbox-isnt-private-how-one-token-opened-mistrals-internal-model-fleet) that a token in the coding sandbox of Mistral's Le Chat let anyone on the internet reach internal Mistral services, including unreleased model checkpoints, agent tools and usage metrics. Vero said Mistral fixed the issue on September 10, 2026.
incidents.description: [Vero Security reported](https://www.vero.security/blog/your-agents-sandbox-isnt-private-how-one-token-opened-mistrals-internal-model-fleet) that a proxy token in the coding sandbox of Mistral's Le Chat gave access to internal Mistral services. According to Vero, these services included unreleased model checkpoints, agent tools and usage metrics, and a prompt injection could also get the token. Vero said that Mistral deployed a fix ten days after its report.

timeline.title: Mistral deploys a fix
timeline.description: Mistral deployed a fix ten days after Vero's report ([Vero Security](https://www.vero.security/blog/your-agents-sandbox-isnt-private-how-one-token-opened-mistrals-internal-model-fleet)).
